name: Mitten Extracts x 3pk Disposables | Flavors of Summer 2025
description:
Introducing the Exclusive Summer Three Pack — all three of our Flavors of Summers Past LTO's, bundled in one collectible box. Creamsiclez, Ice Berry Gelato, and Strawberry Shortcakez—each hit wrapped in bold flavor and nostalgia.

-Creamsiclez is a dreamy blend of juicy orange and smooth vanilla cream, crafted for those sunny summer vibes. This balanced hybrid delivers a mellow, feel-good experience, perfect for laid-back afternoons or creative bursts.

-Ice Berry Gelato is a refreshing fusion of ripe berries, citrus zest, and silky cream. Bursting with fruity flavor and balanced with a cool, smooth finish, this hybrid is your go-to for chill vibes and flavorful sessions. Whether you're winding down or finding your creative spark, Ice Berry Gelato delivers a deliciously mellow high.

-Strawberry Shortcake serves up sweet, candy-like strawberry flavor with a creamy finish that hits just right. This fruity indica brings dessert vibes to your sesh, delivering smooth, uplifting effects perfect for unwinding or sparking creativity. It’s like your favorite treat—only better.
